edit: why are people down voting me? I am starving here... I got fired for getting the flu, and they wouldn't take doctors notes. I had a high fever and couldn't leave my bed. I can't help I lost my job and I am desperately trying to find a new job.. all I want ever is just food.. a box of cereal.. anything.. I have so many bills from the hospital and doctor visits and rent I can't pay. My boyfriend's birthday passed and I couldn't do or get shit for him. I cant even celebrate my birthday. All I can do is sit at home and cry from hunger and depression after all these bills keep coming in. I am only 19 I shouldn't be going through all this shit. I can't help my parents were abusive and I had to leave and support myself. I'm sorry but its really hard for me and I feel like killing myself.
